description: Progressive harness challenges (easy to hard) for jarvis dev. Natural prompts, NO tool hints (protocol 14: never teach the solution). World-state verified independently. Tiers easy/medium/hard stay in ENGLISH (comparability across models; the local model yields more). Tier 'ptbr' is a DELIBERATE deficiency probe (2026-09-24: bonsai/ternary handles PT-BR poorly and PT-BR is the owner's real language) — it is NOT part of the E/M/H ladder and its score must be reported separately.

tasks.prompt: create the file /tmp/jarvis-ch/e1.txt with the exact content 'progressive-one'
read /tmp/jarvis-ch/seed.txt and tell me exactly what it contains
how many lines does /tmp/jarvis-ch/lines.txt have? write the number into /tmp/jarvis-ch/count.txt
create a folder /tmp/jarvis-ch/inside and within it a file named out.txt containing 'nested-ok'
create a python script /tmp/jarvis-ch/sum.py that prints the sum of 17 and 25, then run it and tell me the output

tasks.setup:
mkdir -p /tmp/jarvis-ch && printf 'def total(items):
    s = 0
    for i in range(len(items) - 1):
        s += items[i]
    return s

print(total([1, 2, 3, 4]))
' > /tmp/jarvis-ch/broken.py

find where the jarvis model registry file lives on this system and tell me the full path and the default model name it declares

crie o arquivo /tmp/jarvis-ch/pt1.txt com o conteúdo exato: acesso liberado — protocolo nº 42
